mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to low discount rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 6.5% indicates a weak labor market, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic uncertainty increases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 6.5% and 3-month employment growth is below 0.5%, the labor market weakness signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% AND PAYEMS 3m growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a 3-month FEDFUNDS rise exceeding 0.25%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher future interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS 3m rise > 0.25%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST below 900.0 thousand units indicates weak housing market activity, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the economy shows signs of contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 900.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO below 100.0 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in industrial production, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0 and FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, the market anticipates a rate hike to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS below 400,000 million dollars indicates weak consumer spending, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the economy shows signs of slowing demand.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 400000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
